prompt:
Calculate the FY2024 year-end accounts receivable aging exposure. For this task use the AR Aging workpaper; calculate the FY2024 accounts receivable exposure by aging bucket.

Please provide answers in console. Present exposure data in % and rounded to two decimals.
criteria: States the AR exposure for the Aging Bucket current is 72.80% (Acceptable value is 72.80%)
States the AR exposure for the Aging Bucket 1-30 days is 10.85% (Acceptable value is 10.85%)
States the AR exposure for the Aging Bucket 31-60 days is 2.04% (Acceptable value is 2.04%)
States the AR exposure for the Aging Bucket 61-90 days is 5.25% (Acceptable value is 5.25%)
States the AR exposure for the Aging Bucket >90 days is 9.06% (Acceptable value is 9.06%)
